title: Systematic benchmarking of small variant calling pipelines for long-read RNA sequencing data
abstract: Background: Long-read RNA sequencing (lrRNA-seq) enables transcript-resolved variant detection, but systematic and neutral evaluations of small variants calling pipelines remain limited. The performance of existing tools across sequencing technologies, alignment strategy, variant caller choice, genomic contexts and downstream haplotype phasing is not fully understood.
